timestamp_local: Station timestamp interpreted as Asia/Kolkata; offset retained. Provider timezone confirmation pending.
source_row_number: One-based CSV physical line including five metadata lines and header; missing on added grid rows.
radiation_valid: True when source radiation exists, is finite and nonnegative; no imputation.
source_kind: Provenance: historical station observation or deterministic Astral calculation.
timezone_status: Whether the station timezone was verified; presently interpreted as campus local.
source_row_present: True if a timestamp existed in the original station CSV; false for grid-only rows.
minute_of_day: Local hour times 60 plus minute, 0 to 1439.
day_of_year: One-based local day of year, 1 to 365/366.
year_sin: Sine of annual cycle using zero-based day and actual 365/366-day year, dimensionless.
year_cos: Cosine of annual cycle using zero-based day and actual 365/366-day year, dimensionless.
solar_elevation_deg: Astral geometric elevation at the campus proxy, refraction disabled; not measured local daylight.
geometry_scope: campus_proxy: common astronomical location, not verified fixture or sensor coordinates.
split: Chronological train before September 2024; validation September; test October onward.
expected_slots_in_export_window: 15-minute grid slots inside the export span for this date; final partial day is not forced to 96.
source_rows_present: Number of original station rows on this date.
valid_radiation_slots: Number of finite, nonnegative source radiation readings on this date.
missing_source_slots: Expected grid slots minus original source rows.
missing_or_invalid_radiation_slots: Expected grid slots minus valid radiation readings, including absent rows.
radiation_coverage_fraction: Valid radiation slots divided by expected slots within the export window; 0 to 1.
partial_export_day: True if the export window contains fewer than 96 slots for the date.
location_id: Stable project-assigned location identifier; not a surveyed asset/GPS identifier.
location_name: User-supplied location name, surrounding whitespace removed; spelling preserved.
site_type: outdoor_road or corridor, based on user classification.
fixture_type: floodlight, streetlight or tube_light; incorporates user conversation corrections.
source_workbook_type: Original Type value from the workbook, retained for traceability.
main_obstruction: User-reported category; no quantitative transmission or illuminance implied.
installed_lights: User-assumed installed fixture count; not a measured or field-counted inventory. Counted once across repeated nights.
nonworking_min: Lower scenario count of potentially nonworking fixtures; occasional user estimate, not a dated inspection.
nonworking_max: Upper scenario count of potentially nonworking fixtures; occasional user estimate, not a dated inspection.
working_lights_min: Installed minus nonworking_max; corridor value includes all installed fixtures.
working_lights_max: Installed minus nonworking_min; corridor value includes all installed fixtures.
availability_basis: Road: occasional user failure estimate. Corridor: no failures reported, all installed used for calculation.
rated_power_w: Fixed per-fixture calculation power: floodlight 200, streetlight 90, LED tube/batten variant 20 W.
power_basis: Published manufacturer rating selected for calculation; not measured campus power.
power_source_id: Identifier of the power-rating reference in project_config.json.
power_source_url: Manufacturer page supporting the selected rating, not evidence of installed campus model.
installed_model_verified: False until the installed model is confirmed from a label or campus record.
technology_status: LED example used for calculation; installed lamp technology has not been verified.
latitude: Exact location latitude, currently missing pending verification.
longitude: Exact location longitude, currently missing pending verification.
coordinate_status: Status of individual location coordinates; currently unverified.
astronomy_latitude: Common campus proxy latitude from the documented ASDMA source, not individual location GPS.
astronomy_longitude: Common campus proxy longitude from the documented ASDMA source, not individual location GPS.
timezone: IANA timezone for local switching records and derived campus astronomy.
inventory_source: User workbook plus explicit conversation corrections to type/count interpretation.
observation_id: Stable location ID plus ON calendar date; one observed overnight interval.
on_timestamp_local: Observed ON date/time supplied by user, interpreted in campus local timezone.
off_timestamp_local: Observed OFF date/time supplied by user, interpreted in campus local timezone.
night_start_date: Local calendar date of the observed ON event, YYYY-MM-DD.
manual_on_duration_hours: Elapsed hours from observed ON to observed OFF; continuous operation is not independently verified.
timing_basis: user_observed: switching endpoints were described by user as actual observations.
timing_resolution_minutes: Observation uncertainty/cadence not supplied; missing, not assumed minute-level precision.
source_excel_row: One-based row in the original Fill here sheet.
source_sheet: Name of original workbook sheet containing the observation.
continuous_on_between_endpoints_verified: False: only endpoints were supplied, no continuous electrical-state log.
working_fixture_hours_min: Minimum working-light scenario times manual interval hours.
working_fixture_hours_max: Maximum working-light scenario times manual interval hours.
manual_energy_kwh_min: Minimum working fixture-hours times fixed rated power divided by 1000; estimated manual consumption.
manual_energy_kwh_max: Maximum working fixture-hours times fixed rated power divided by 1000; estimated manual consumption.
energy_basis: Calculation presumes continuous ON operation at rated power, no dimming or meter measurements.
civil_dawn_local: Astral dawn at solar depression 6 degrees using the campus proxy and unobstructed horizon.
sunrise_local: Astral sunrise at campus proxy, no local obstruction adjustment; not an OFF recommendation.
solar_noon_local: Astral local solar noon at the campus proxy.
sunset_local: Astral sunset at campus proxy, no local obstruction adjustment; not an ON recommendation.
civil_dusk_local: Astral dusk at solar depression 6 degrees using the campus proxy and unobstructed horizon.
installed_count_basis: Provenance of installed count: user_assumed_not_field_counted, confirmed by the user.
